> A single skill for planning a revise-and-resubmit: it breaks referee and editor reports into atomic tasks, classifies them, has the user map dependencies between them, and checks that graph with a bundled NetworkX script before grouping the work into sequenced blocks with decision and co-author sync points. The skill ships as a packaged .skill archive meant for upload through the Claude settings rather than as a browsable SKILL.md, and the README is candid about its limits (no effort estimates, no response-letter drafting, a block template tuned to empirical accounting and finance papers). No licence declared: skill texts are not reproduced here; each skill links to its source.
